About this business
Contractors
A&C Quality Air, LLC, is your local cooling, and heating professional. We help keep your home comfortable. Contact us for a free estimate. We look forward to earning your business. We are fast, friendly, and dependable. Serving Clifton,Clifton, East Rutherford, Fair Lawn, Ridgewood Essex County, Bergen County, and Passaic County. Our Services include HVAC contracting, heating installation, service and repair, air conditioning installation, service, and repair, boiler installation, service and repair, hot water heater installation, service and repair, forced air, heat pumps, ductless mini splits, for commercial and residential clients.

Eve St John 
on Google
3 months ago

Caesar, was so great to work with. He is very knowledgeable , honest, hard worker. He fixed our Central AC unit which was fairly new which was installed by another contractor who didn’t bother to even come and look to fix it. some parts were still under warranty , Caesar, dealt with getting it all done. Getting a new compressor under the warranty, His prices for his labor are very fair. I highly recommend him for his competitive prices and his good work. 

Marianne Cafaro 
on Google
2 months ago

Caesar and his team at A&C installed a replacement air handler and compressor at our home. They were extremely professional, clean, and did exactly what was promised. He was even able to solve a problem with our duct work that restricted air flow to our upper floor bedrooms. We have a completely new central air system abd could not be happier with his work. Honest, good work at a fair price. If you are considering A&C hire them and don’t look back you won’t regret it. 

Andrew Passaro 
on Google
a month ago

AC Quality Air is the one. My AC unit recently went out, and the level of service I received was absolutely amazing from start to finish. They arrived on time, I will absolutely be using them for all my future HVAC needs because Cesar was very meticulous in every aspect of his work they made the entire experience seamless and worry-free. The team was professional, courteous, and exceptionally thorough. Cesar and his team took the time to inspect my unit, fix the root cause of the problem, and even gave me a few tips on how t... read more

Kelly Lopez 
on Google
a month ago

The few times I’ve had an emergency, Cesar answered and addressed our issues immediately and either came the same day or the following day. He’s reliable, efficient, explains in detail and doesn’t rush the job. I’ve used other services in the past and have decided to contact A&C quality only moving forward. He’s very knowledgeable and I trust he knows what he’s doing with our very dated machine. He doesn’t push services or unnecessary work. Highly recommend. 

Dan Royce 
on Google
2 months ago

I appreciate Cesar and his crew. They were so thorough, efficient, and helpful throughout this whole process of replacing our old air conditioning system. This company is extremely responsive and quick - from the first call to the installation, we moved along very quickly. They took their time to ensure all our equipment was carefully installed, while fixing up any old ducts or parts. This was the full service, and I highly recommend him for whatever your home needs.
